content:
The v4.21.0-rc3 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language.

Please read the release notes for details.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets and Mathlib are now available for v4.21.0-rc3 via a v4.21.0-rc3 tag, if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
